title: Talented artist, Hiram Torres has taken her chances to dive deep into her creativity with the release of her recent track.
htmlContent:
American music artist Hiram Torres is a talented singer and songwriter taking over the industry by storm with the release of her latest track, "Smiles Like Buscemi." After being motivated by other hip-hop artists, Hiram Torres has taken her chances to dive deep into her creativity.

Hiram Torres's "Smile Like Buscemi" is her most recent single produced by frequent collaborator Rei Kae. She cultivates another devilish offering of aggressive 808s with a ferocious, sharp flow. She is daring in her approach, with a dope flow and intense lyrics, while creating a unique sound that her fanbase will love.
